grad.sign_note: bundle vectors of the behaviour reader dir (3판): fp16 unit rows x fp32 norms of the summed -dL/dh, i.e. stored +dL/dh summed over the bundle's examples and negated; inputs = -(sum over the bundle's examples of +dL/dh): the descent direction, stored as fp32

act.sign_note: activation sums of the behaviour gradient store: per layer the stored full_act rows (output of model.model.layers[L], positions 1..n-2 of each chunk: position 0 is stored apart as pos0_act, the last position is in no stored sum) of the input's documents, fp16 unit x fp32 norm, summed in fp32; no negation, no centring, no rescaling; stored as fp32
